summary: Short Road to VR news item showing leaked external and internal photos of Pico's Space Pro headset, taken from Japanese MIC regulatory filings. It says the ByteDance-owned Pico cancelled a launch event earlier in the month and postponed the reveal. The device, codenamed 'Project Swan', is expected in Q4 2026 and has also appeared in FCC filings. The text contains no discussion of AI, personal context, agents or voice interfaces.
speakers_or_authors: Road to VR staff (trade press journalism)
relevance_reason: This is a hardware leak about a VR/mixed-reality headset, positioned as a rival to Apple Vision Pro. It has no connection to AI-driven interaction, personal-context devices, computer-use agents or voice interfaces.

claims.claim: Pico cancelled its planned early-month launch event for Space Pro and postponed the reveal and release date.
claims.quote: Space Pro was initially meant to debut earlier this month, however the ByteDance subsidiary cancelled the event and postponed its reveal and release date.

claims.claim: The device has no official release date beyond an expected Q4 2026 window, and it has appeared in both Japanese and FCC filings, which the article suggests means launch could be imminent.
claims.quote: the device has also surfaced in FCC filings in addition to the Japanese equivalent, suggesting it could be any day now.

commercial_interest: The article carries an affiliate-link disclosure, which is standard for the publication. No vendor is speaking about its own product.
older_event: No. The item reports a recent leak and a launch postponement from the same month. There is nothing about AI interaction.
